name: printing-press-x-cli
description: Agent-native social CLI harness, starting with X.

scripts.smoke: node src/cli.mjs --help && node src/cli.mjs profile list --json && node src/cli.mjs post x --profile smoke --text "hello" --dry-run --json && node src/cli.mjs post x --profile smoke --text "hello" --media test/fixtures/sample.mp4 --dry-run --json && node src/cli.mjs comment x --profile smoke --url https://x.com/user/status/123 --text "nice" --dry-run --json && node src/cli.mjs dm x --profile smoke --to testuser --text "hello" --dry-run --json
